headline: Approve the machining center

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body: The panel agrees the case clears the hurdle. A net present value of {{npv}} is positive, and payback of {{payback_years}} years sits inside the policy limit of {{max_payback_years}} years. If yearly cash flows come in a tenth light, the net present value of {{npv_flows_minus_10}} stays positive. A fifth light still leaves a net present value of {{npv_flows_minus_20}}. A condition is not required.

disagreements_addressed: No material disagreement. The sponsor, the stress test, and operations all support going ahead.
